Name: Four Corners Map Edit- Two Halves
Author: Pecilia
Description:
Replaces the Four Corners Farm map with and edited version meant for 2 players instead of 4. Requires SMAPI and ContentPatcher.

The overall changes were made with 2 players competing against each other. Would've gave both halves the mini quarries but I'm new at this to figure out how to set that as a tile property on the left side.

Changes are as followed:
[list]
[*]Replaces the Lake in the bottom-left corner with grass.
[*]Replaces the mini quarry in the bottom-right corner with grass.
[*]Opened up the overall paths between the top and bottoms.
[*]Removed one of the little water pools to even out the two sides water source. 
[*]Added a sussy middleground
[*]Made the path to zone north stairs, for some reason.
[/list]
